name: CircleSeeker-benchmark
description: Adds simulation/ so that the benchmark is reproducible end to end from this repository alone: truth-set construction, RCA concatemer and platform read simulation, the PBSIM2 error models, and the HeLa_HiFi_2k sampling profile derived from 2,000 empirical HiFi reads. Also records CircleSeeker v1.6.1 as the benchmarked version (the archived results in results/ are from that rerun) and updates repository links. This is the release accompanying Zhang et al., "MMC-seq enables efficient long-read eccDNA profiling from low-input samples".
